When It All Started

Thirty years of trust between growers and wholesalers.

In 1992, under the sun-kissed skies of the south of France, Ross Armstrong — a visionary English entrepreneur — founded Rossmark. What began as a personal quest for warmth soon evolved into a dynamic business bridging French fruit and vegetable producers with European wholesalers.

Ross wasted no time catalyzing operations, exporting a diverse range of produce including apples, salads, apricots and peaches. The foundation was laid on reliability, efficiency, and a commitment to delivering the best from local French farms to eager European markets.

“In the face of an industry that evolved at a rapid pace, Rossmark adapted and thrived — from French produce to sourcing across Europe and North Africa.”

What We Do

Two disciplines, one standard of excellence.

01 — Distribution

Sourced from the best soils in Europe & North Africa

What began as a French export house now sources primarily from Spain, Morocco, Italy and the rich soils of Mauritania — ensuring the freshest produce reaches our customers, whatever the season.

Tomatoes Aubergines Cucumbers Peppers Stone Fruits Melon Nuts Citrus
02 — Production

Growing our own, from Morocco to Mauritania

As the sector evolved, we transitioned from middleman to grower — cultivating across Africa in partnership with AC Nature, growing year-round for European tables.

Watermelons Honeydew Melon Piel de Sapo Charentais Melon Peppers Herbs

Our Partner

AC Nature — growing across Africa, year-round.

AC Nature, led by Abderrahim Chakra, brings deep agricultural expertise across Morocco and Mauritania. Rossmark partners with AC Nature — with Liam Armstrong leading our side of the collaboration — to grow fresh produce across Africa every month of the year.

May–Jun: Watermelon, Piel de Sapo, Sweetcorn Sep+: California Peppers, Herbs Nov–Jan: Yellow & Mini Watermelons
